title: RoboCert Planar-2R Certification Problem
description: User-facing input for `robocert certify`. Every numeric quantity is written as a decimal string or an integer and parsed to an exact rational; JSON float literals are rejected so no value silently loses precision.

joint_limits.description: Radian intervals, each strictly inside (-pi, pi). Converted to exact rational tan(q/2) bounds by INWARD rounding, so the certified interval is a subset of the one requested.

target.description: Requested tool point [x, y]. The certified point is the exact rational point the witness reaches; its deviation from this request is reported exactly.

obstacle.description: Optional. Omitted means no obstacle is modeled, which is not the same as certifying that none is present.

clearance.description: Required separation beyond the obstacle radius, strictly positive.

singularity.description: Lower bound on |det J| in square length units, strictly positive and at most |L1*L2| (proof P2 Corollary 5.4; larger is unsatisfiable for every configuration).

units.description: Declarative only; the certificate is dimensionless arithmetic over the supplied numbers. Mixing units is the caller's error to avoid (AGENTS.md 22.2).

oneOf.description: Decimal string such as "7.8", or a rational such as "39/5". Parsed exactly.
